claims.statement: OffersBoard's single always-mounted role=status line names the viewer's own claim outcome: the loser of a 409 race sees 'Missed it...' (no longer open, someone else claimed, or retired) and the winner sees 'You claimed it. This one is yours.'. A local Playwright race with two signed-in Chromium sessions against Postgres 16 passed 5 of 5 runs (exactly one 200 and one 409, loser and winner lines as stated, database claimed_by = winner), and a 10-request concurrent burst passed 5 of 5 with exactly one 200; that harness is not committed. bun run validate exits 0 (233 tests) and the repo's E2E suite passes on Chromium. Owner review is not established.

commands.command: playwright test (repo e2e, Chromium, local Postgres 16)
playwright test e2e-local/claim-race.spec.ts --repeat-each=5 (local harness, not committed)
